candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; cannot confirm whether redis is slow, saturated, or unreachable versus network path.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) causing 503 on /v1/reservations and ReadTimeout cascading to 502 on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~2406ms matching the ~2s dependency timeout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Redis-side evidence is unavailable, so root cause is bounded to redis timeout at the inventory dependency.
